paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst, International role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role caught my eye because it works directly with subsidiaries across countries on month end, forecasts and budgets, which is close to what I did supporting a regional team from abroad.

At Thomson Reuters I worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and closing activities for the ANZ region, and executed reconciliation work with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and ran variance analyses on budget reallocation.

That lines up with producing monthly P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reporting and keeping subsidiary submissions on time. I'm used to coordinating across time zones and chasing data until it ties out. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
